If affordability is the priority, I’d shortlist smaller GTA/Newmarket shops that let you buy only the pieces you need, rather than a big full-service retainer.

My shortlist

RC Design — Newmarket. Strong fit if you want content + social + paid ads under one roof. They offer social/content, paid social, PPC, SEO and reporting. 
Ducero Digital Marketing

Manisoft Media — Newmarket. Particularly interesting if your business needs regular photos/video and social content as well as marketing. Their packages include content planning, shooting, editing and posting.

Rosewood Marketing — Newmarket. Full-service option with Google/Meta advertising, social media, content and in-house photo/video; they explicitly work with small businesses and trades/service businesses. 
Rosewood Marketing

Most Exposure — Aurora. Worth getting a quote if you want a more performance-oriented combination of Google Ads, Meta ads and SEO.

Geek Power — Newmarket. More web/digital focused, but offers SEO, Google Ads and social marketing; worth considering if your website also needs work.

WSI Comandix Marketing Inc. — Newmarket. Established local agency with an emphasis on measurable lead generation and conversions.

Two particularly interesting price benchmarks

VOOFA publishes unusually concrete pricing: Google Ads management starts at $450/month for ad budgets under $2,000, with a $1,250 setup fee. They advertise no minimum and pay-as-you-go terms. 
VOOFA

Kavana Digital publishes $499/month + $999 setup for Google Ads management, although they recommend at least $1,000/month in ad spend. Their combined website + Ads + SEO package is $999/month. 
Kavana Digital

So I'd use roughly $450–$650/month management + your actual ad spend as one benchmark when asking local agencies for quotes.

What I'd do for a local service business

Don't start by buying "social media management." I'd ask each provider for a 90-day lead-generation package consisting of:

Google Business Profile optimization

8–12 useful pieces of local/service content

Google Search Ads targeting your highest-value services

Simple landing page + call/form tracking

A small amount of Meta/social content if there's a genuine visual angle

Monthly reporting on leads and cost per lead, not impressions/followers

That will make it much easier to compare agencies apples-to-apples.

My first three calls: RC Design for an all-around local option, Manisoft if content/video is important, and VOOFA/Kavana as pricing benchmarks for paid search.

If you tell me what type of service business you run and roughly what you can spend per month (e.g. $1k, $2k, $5k), I can narrow this to 3 providers and compare their likely fit.
